Pak Translation Sample Projects

Localization

Localization is not an easy task. It involves specialized knowledge of the source and target languages and cultures and it also involves knowledge of tags and placeholders. It has been an amazing journey providing our clients with reliable localization services. For several years now, we have been regularly localizing the content of one of the leading mobile phone companies into Urdu. We have localized millions of words, maintaining 99% or above accuracy.

Localizing, revising, QA’ing, and style guide development in Indian Punjabi for the website of a healthcare company in the USA was quite challenging. Time was limited and we needed to cater to all four parts of the project mentioned above. We assigned the work to 4 Indian Punjabi linguists who did their work efficiently and we were able to deliver work with 100% accuracy.

Document Translation

Translation of children’s books for a school based in the USA was fun. It was challenging too. You need to use simple and familiar language that is not always easy. We tried our best to choose words and phrases that the target readership can easily understand. Our client was satisfied with our efforts.

We have been regularly translating legal content in South Asian languages. Until recently, our output was at least 30,000 words translated in this domain. Most of these documents are claim forms, but we also receive certificates (marriage, death, wills, etc.), land record forms, court proceedings, legal contracts, and court orders for translation. 

Audio/Video Transcription and Translation

52 Minutes of AV Translation (Balochi into English): Balochi is a rare language in terms of the availability of reliable and competent AV translators. Our translator is one of the few good translators who did this job (which was an interview about the situation of the people of Balochistan) within the deadline. The translation was QA’ed by us and then sent to the client.

Around Two Hours of AV Translation (Mongolian into English): For this urgent project involving interviews about Mongolian history, sports, and tradition, 5 translators and revisers worked on the files and we managed to deliver good-quality work.

Subtitling

18 Hours of Interviews: For this big project (a number of interviews mostly about the CPEC project in Balochistan) involving creating SRT files in English, we assigned the task to around 10 subtitlers. Their work was reviewed by 2 other linguists to make sure we deliver high-quality work to the client. With teamwork, we were able to complete the project successfully and as per the requirements of the client.

We are always on the lookout for quality-oriented, responsive, and honest language professionals. If it sounds like you, please fill out the form below, and we will get back to you if your detail matches our requirements. Please write ‘N/A’ for the fields that are not relevant. Process: You submit the form. Our HR department reviews the details. If they meet our requirements, we guide you about the screening and onboarding process and, if everything goes well, we add your details on the file to contact you for relevant projects in future.

For translators, we send them a short test (comprising fewer than 200 words) with the aim to assess their skills and understand what type of content they can translate better. It is important that the translators meet our standards/expectations in the test. For content writers and editors, we ask them to show us their sample work in order to understand their writing skills.

Get In Touch!

Pak Translation Services

LOCALIZATION

Pak Translations offers top-notch localization services through a pool of experienced localizers who are adept in the art of adapting content to local markets, while remaining sensitive to local cultural and language norms.

DOCUMENT TRANSLATION

Be it brochures, certificates, SMS messages, affidavits, court summons, medical reports, or any other document, Pak Translations has the experts who can transfer your message into other languages, maintaining both accuracy and readability.

EDITING & PROOFREADING

It is crucial to have your documents, websites, and subtitles error-free and presented in the required format & layout. This is where our expert editors and proofreaders come in. They can ensure that the final version you get is both spotless and natural sounding.

AUDIO/VIDEO TRANSCRIPTION & TRANSLATION

Transcription & translation of audio/video files is a demanding art requiring insertion of accurate time-codes and faithful rendition of speech (concurrently ensuring that the output is understandable to the readers). High concentration and an ability to comprehend the speech despite background noise and interruptions are a key to success in this art. Harnessed with these skills, our experts are ready to serve you.

INTERPRETING

As it needs to be done on spot, interpreting is a service service, requiring not only good command of languages involved, but also an ability to quickly process the speech and translate it into another language in your mind. It, obviously, needs profound competence, as the margin of error is almost none. Our interpreters are there to interpret for you efficiently and in different formats: in person, over the phone and via videoconferencing. Both consecutive & simultaneous interpretation services are available.

SUBTITLING

Subtitling is even more demanding than audio/video transcription, in that it requires precise synchronization between subtitles and time-codes as well as preparation of files in various formats such as SubRip and VobSub and open or close subtitles/captions. We, at Pak Translations, cater to our clients’ specific subtitling needs with efficiency and accuracy, and we can prepare both soft and hard subtitles.

CONTENT CREATION

We are blessed with a pool of creative writers who have years of experience in writing convincing and attractive content. We are talking about all type of content, including, but not limited to, blog articles, social media posts, print and digital ads, case stories, email marketing content, and presentations. Our expert writers are always there to help you to reach out to your targeted audience in an effective and appealing way.

FOREIGN LANGUAGE MATERIAL DEVELOPMENT

We provide expert services in developing reading, writing, and listening tests for foreign/second language learners in accordance with the proficiency levels set by the clients. Apart from testing, we are expert in collating and creating listening, writing, and reading passages to be used as practice material in language learning classes.

LINGUISTICS-RELATED SERVICES

Be it phonetic transcription, pronunciation validation, PoS (parts of speech) or case tagging, stress placement, or assistance with building a corpus or dictionary, we are here to fulfill your needs. Our expertise in this regard has been well-proven in the projects we have carried out so far, and the testimonials from our clients are a proof of it.

DESKTOP PUBLISHING

We have DTP services available for our clients. Whether it is brochures, flyers, and books or any other documents, we can do typesetting, formatting, layout adjustment, and designing in accordance with your specific needs.

About Us

A NAME TO RELY UPON

PAK Translations cherishes the aim of providing quality language services to its clients, thereby helping them get their message across clearly and effectively or reach new markets. Founded on the principles of commitment, honesty, perseverance, and simplicity, the company concentrates on offering excellent services in Asian and European languages at present. This includes both major and minor languages. The company has done its best to assort top talent in these languages, so that our clients get all their language needs fulfilled for the said languages and regions with satisfaction and confidence.

NOTE: PAK Translations is very particular about quality, and usually all of its linguists go through a process of rigorous testing. Moreover, the company keeps a check on the quality of its linguists, so as to be able to provide quality services to its clients on a consistent basis. As a result, we have constantly been delivering top quality work to our clients, making us a preferable choice for them.

Meet the Founder

Muhammad Salman Riaz has a Ph.D. in Translation Studies from the University of Leeds, UK and an M.Phil in Linguistics from National University of Modern Languages, Pakistan. He holds over 10 years’ experience of providing translation/localization, review, QA, transcription, subtitling, language proficiency test development, phonetic, and morpho-syntactic services. He has a track record of exceeding the expectations of his clients and, by establishing Pak Translations, he intends and strives to provide the same level of quality services in all Asian and European languages.

Why Choose Pak Translations ?

A variety of Language Services

Professional language needs vary from document translation to website localization to various phonetic and morphosyntactic requirements to, say, develop text-to-speech (TTS) software. Keeping this in view, Pak Translations serves as a one-stop shop for all your language needs (for detail, refer to our Services). We make sure to serve with top class service and envision to become a leading translation providing company in the world.

Excellent Customer Support

We are always there for our customers, even after office hours. We try to answer their queries in as much detail as we can and we value their feedback. The support we provide to them is not limited to the duration of the project. We are there to respond to any queries and requirements even after the delivery of the project.

Quality Control

Quality control is the backbone of a successful business. As the first step in this regard, we select our language experts only after rigorously testing their skills. Our Translator Instructions (shared with all linguists as part of the onboarding process) bind them to check their deliverables thoroughly before delivering to us. We also run QA on the translation delivered by them. Also, as mentioned earlier, we are always there to answer any post-delivery queries and concerns by clients – a step that helps us ensure that the quality  is up to the client’s expectations.

On-time Delivery & Competitive Prices

We make sure to deliver work to clients on time. In the case of any unforeseen potential delays (such as a linguist falling ill), we inform our clients in time and take prompt actions to assign the work to another linguist in our team. Despite the fact that we deliver top-notch services to our clients, we offer reasonable prices to our clients and keep their available budget in view.

Get a Quick Quote!

Alternatively

Use the following link to give us a detailed description of your needs so that we understand your order better. Place Order

How it Works?

Understanding

We discuss the project requirements with you, asking questions, requesting for reference/helpful material, and/or providing suggestions for better results.

Order

You place the order using the order placement form.

Assignment

Considering your requirements, we assign the project to the most-relevant linguist, who deliver it after competing and proofreading it.

QA

We perform the final check on the project for any formatting, layout, punctuation, missing-line, etc. issues.

Delivery

We deliver the project to you by the deadline.

Post-Delivery Support

We are there to resolve any post-delivery concerns or answer any questions.
